name: Turkmenistan

findings.local_actor: Altyn Asyr (state mobile operator); Turkmenaragatnashyk Agency
findings.summary: Turkmenaragatnashyk was authorised to contract Huawei for equipment, software, licences, installation and support to expand the Altyn Asyr mobile network in Ahal, Balkan and Dashoguz provinces and Ashgabat.
findings.analyst_inference: Huawei supplies the RAN equipment and support, so pole prc. Tier 3 on a named-counterparty contract; value undisclosed and signature not independently confirmed (Trend relays Turkmen state agency TDH, a government announcement). Two opened S3 sources but no S1/S2, so not corroborated. Covers four of six regions, coded national.

findings.local_actor: Altyn Asyr (state mobile operator); Turkmenaragatnashyk Agency
findings.summary: In the same 2021 decision, Nokia was to supply equipment, software, licences, installation and support for the Altyn Asyr mobile network in Lebap and Mary provinces.
findings.analyst_inference: Nokia (Finland) as equipment vendor, so pole third. Tier 3 on a named-counterparty contract authorisation; value undisclosed. Single opened S3 source relaying Turkmen state agency TDH. Two provinces, so subnational.

findings.local_actor: Turkmentelecom and Ashgabat city telephone network (GTS); Transport and Communications Agency
findings.summary: An Islamic Development Bank-financed contract to expand the fixed telephone network of Turkmentelecom and Ashgabat's GTS was awarded to Huawei, covering equipment, software, licences, installation and technical support across provinces and Ashgabat.
findings.analyst_inference: Huawei as equipment vendor, so pole prc. Tier 3 on IsDB contract award notice naming Huawei; value not stated on the notice. DCD reported the January decree (year not shown, likely 2023) before award. IsDB is the financier and does not set the pole.

findings.local_actor: Turkmen authorities (operator not named; likely Altyn Asyr)
findings.summary: Authorities launched a 5G mobile network in the new city of Arkadag, deployed with Huawei, following a 4G+ rollout there in February 2025.
findings.analyst_inference: Huawei as equipment vendor, so pole prc. Tier 5 as a launched live service, but in one showcase city only, so municipal. Single opened S3 source citing official statements. A later 5G launch in Awaza (Oct 2026, Trend) named no vendor and is not coded.

findings.summary: A Turkmen education ministry delegation met OpenAI at the Education World Forum in London to discuss ChatGPT Edu and possible pilots at selected academic institutions; no pilot or agreement was confirmed.
findings.analyst_inference: Service used via OpenAI, so pole us; base_model null as no model weights are held nationally. Coded tier 1 as the weakest instrument (talks only, below a signed MOU). Report relays Turkmen state outlet Golden Age.
